name: commit-attribution
description: Always-on commit attribution policy for AI coding agents: never add a Co-Authored-By AI trailer or 'Generated with' footer to commits; if AI assistance is worth noting, mention it in one short prose line instead.

source.title: Commit Attribution Baseline
source.relationship: Mirrored from the work toolkit's commit-attribution pack — the trailer/footer attribution rules are tool-neutral and not employer-specific, so this personal copy applies to any repository outside work.
